correctness_confidence.basis: The quadratic terms in the necessary determinant inequality cancel. The reported rational tolerance admits a construction checked in all 720 cells; the lower and upper values coincide.

rigor.basis: The class of positive length and nonnegative rate products, normalization ambiguity, error norm and zero columns are identified. Dollar or euro billing error is not inferred from a component discrepancy.

novelty.basis: Positive rank-one approximation and the toll schedule are prior work. An exact obstruction localized to two vehicle profiles and two specific A12 sections, globally sharp even after adding carbon disclosures, is a new result of this comparison.

significance.basis: The schedule can now serve as a reproducible test of route-pricing implementations. The excess over a fourth-decimal rounding allowance is only around 4.5 millionths of a euro.

reproducibility.basis: The source manifest and PDF are hash-bound. The independent rational checker verifies the table sums, corridor-model certificates and section-level factors without requiring the optimization packages.

summary: I examined the four rendered pages of this PDF and participated in its preparation. Section 4 pairs a four-charge determinant inequality with feasible factors for the full 15-by-48 matrix. That proves an exact best achievable worst error even when the profile-specific external-cost rates are free. A second binding rectangle isolates the smaller carbon error. The operational contribution is an audit of one price schedule, with no invoice observation or demonstration of economic harm.
strengths: A small lower witness explains why more precision in unprinted rates cannot suffice.
The witness for the upper bound covers all allowed vehicle classes and both external charges.
The exact carbon-only threshold and the positive example on fourteen sections localize the incompatibility.
weaknesses: Evidence comes from a single edition and one corridor.
The mapping of the differently labelled geographical and accounting endpoints is justified by the totals but lacks an independent map or route identifier.
No actual trip or transaction is studied.
potential_errors: The unknown factors are identifiable only up to a common scale; their numerical values are not surveyed distances.
The uniform component residual and the cent-level route-price discrepancies have different meanings and units of display.
Allowing separate unprinted rates by vehicle profile is more permissive than a tariff that ties rates across profiles.
strong_novelty_candidates: A four-cell lower bound is attained on the entire Austrian external-charge matrix despite 716 additional entries.
